description: This Java source file defines the 'SubjectModified' class, representing an event emitted after a 'Subject' entity was modified within the policy framework of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances, serialization/deserialization from JSON, and accessors for properties like label and subject.

classes.name: SubjectModified
classes.description: An immutable event class representing a 'subjectModified' event in the Ditto policy system, which captures details about modifications to a Subject, including label and subject data, and provides JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating instances of SubjectModified with various parameters including policy ID, label, subject, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to create a SubjectModified instance from JSON string or object, parsing relevant fields and metadata.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Accessor for the label of the policy entry associated with this event.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Accessor for the subject that was modified.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the subject entity for the event, respecting the given schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer to the resource path affected by this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SubjectModified with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Augments the JSON payload with label, subject ID, and subject details for serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the object, including label and subject.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class, label, subject, and superclass properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the instance, including label and subject details.
